description: Eligibility and binary-brier-v1 vectors: records in; counts and per-candidate status, reasons and loss out.

conventions.results: keyed by candidate record id; every candidate in a case is listed
conventions.counts: only the listed counts are asserted
conventions.loss: exact binary64 value; d = p - o; loss = d * d

records.resolution_rule: Resolves 1 if the first published January 2027 value is strictly below 400000 TEU; resolves 0 if it is 400000 TEU or above. If no qualifying value is published by the resolution deadline, the outcome is unresolved (never 0 and never 0.5).

quote.exact: Freight disruption could intensify next winter if the canal closes.

text_quote.suffix: Nobody can put a date on that.

records.author: analyst:example-analyst-1
records.proposed_target: Meridian Canal corridor freight-delay index (fictional) above 120 in at least one month

condition.note: The speaker did not define closure.

assumptions: "the canal" is identified as the Meridian Canal from the host's preceding question
"next winter" is read as December 2026 through February 2027
"intensify" is read as index > 120, since the speaker gave no threshold
